quizzes.title: Communication Style
quizzes.hook: Do you hint, explain, or say exactly what you mean?

low.title: The Subtext Reader
low.description: You communicate with context, tone and implication and often expect other people to notice the signals around the words.

mid.title: The Context Builder
mid.description: You usually make your point clear while adjusting how direct you are to the person and situation.

high.title: The Clear Signal
high.description: You prefer explicit language, concrete expectations and saying what you mean rather than relying on interpretation.

quizzes.title: Trust Style
quizzes.hook: Is trust your starting point or something people earn?

low.title: The Verifier
low.description: You prefer evidence and consistency before relying on someone, especially when the cost of being wrong is meaningful.

mid.title: The Gradual Truster
mid.description: You begin reasonably open but let repeated behavior determine how much access and confidence someone receives.

high.title: The Open Hand
high.description: You tend to start from goodwill and are comfortable giving people a meaningful chance before they fully prove themselves.

quizzes.title: Self-Discipline
quizzes.hook: Can you keep going when motivation disappears?

low.title: The Motivation Surfer
low.description: Your output is strongly shaped by interest and energy, and forcing low-motivation work can be difficult.

mid.title: The Momentum Keeper
mid.description: You can follow through without perfect motivation when the goal matters and the system is manageable.

high.title: The Finisher
high.description: You are relatively good at acting from commitment rather than mood and can keep moving through repetitive or unexciting work.

quizzes.title: Optimism
quizzes.hook: When the future is uncertain, what does your mind predict first?

low.title: The Risk Scanner
low.description: Your mind naturally looks for what could go wrong, which can help you prepare but may make uncertainty feel heavier.

mid.title: The Realistic Hopeful
mid.description: You can see both risk and possibility and usually adjust your expectations to the evidence in front of you.

high.title: The Possibility Seeker
high.description: You naturally notice upside and often expect that problems can be solved even when the path is not yet obvious.

quizzes.title: Stress Response
quizzes.hook: Under pressure, do you slow down, stabilize, or accelerate?

low.title: The Pause Response
low.description: Pressure tends to make you stop, withdraw or reduce input until you can regain a sense of control.

mid.title: The Stabilizer
mid.description: You may feel the pressure, but you usually regain enough structure to choose a next step without fully shutting down or speeding up.

high.title: The Mobilizer
high.description: Pressure often pushes you toward action, problem-solving and increased pace, especially when there is something concrete to do.
